source_checks.finding: Page General troubleshooting Step 3 gives the path Start > Settings > Bluetooth & Devices > Printers & scanners, says select the printer, Remove, then confirm with Yes (exact words: 'Select the Remove button. Then confirm you're sure you want to remove this device by selecting Yes.'), says make sure the printer is turned on and connected then select Add device (or Refresh), and says use Add manually if the device is not listed. Step 4 says most printers require the latest driver and to continue to step 5 if it still fails. The verified excerpt matches the page. The passage's 'from the manufacturer or the linked driver guide' wording is a paraphrase of the driver step and is supported. Applies to Windows, the user's platform.

required_actions.action: Open Start > Settings > Bluetooth & Devices > Printers & scanners and remove the printer
Make sure the printer is turned on and connected before re-adding
Select Add device or Refresh to find the printer again
If the printer is not listed, select Add manually
If printing still fails, install the latest printer driver
